data.title: Bloc leader's X account restored 2 weeks after bitcoin hack
data.description: Bloc Québécois Leader Yves-François Blanchet says social media platform X has restored his account two weeks after it was hacked and started promoting Bitcoin — which is almost as long as it took for ...
